value.rationale: Source proposes nonoversampled deterministic DEIM row selection with reported quality/runtime tradeoffs but lacks an exact stability guarantee. An attained necessary-and-sufficient dimension/condition-number bound identifies when this natural algorithm cannot guarantee residual decrease; the distinct unbounded branch for arbitrarily well-conditioned matrices in sufficiently large dimensions materially motivates oversampling or true-residual safeguards. The exact threshold is an algorithm design criterion, not a minor numerical constant.
